entities.summary: Tye Smith is an American professional football cornerback for the Orlando Pirates of the Indoor Football League (IFL). He played college football for the Towson Tigers and was selected by the Seattle Seahawks in the fifth round of the 2015 NFL draft. He has also been a member of the Washington Redskins, Tennessee Titans, Minnesota Vikings, Orlando Guardians, and Memphis Showboats.
